steps.description: Timer1 16-bit software reload overflow triggers Timer1_IRQHandler toggling P32 (pin 26). Post-fix deterministic model value: 5000Hz = nominal 100us period (200 counts @ Fsys/12), the pre-ADR-0078 at-anchored design: the software reload applies from the overflow instant and the native backend does not model interrupt latency (ADR-0076), so per-SFR-access proxy billing must not leak into the firmware-visible period. The old 4260Hz target was an ADR-0078-era artifact (proxy billing mistaken for ISR latency); PLAN-20260924-MCS51-T01-OVERFLOW-REARM-FIX re-anchored it.
